'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Erich Hawbaker DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Erich Hawbaker]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Erich E Hawbaker
* '''Username:''' Der Junker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
